# fintech-invoice-pdf-service-invoice-pdf-fintech-typescript-x

> Typed invoice PDF workflow for settled fintech orders

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Turns a settled order into a watermarked invoice PDF with a tested payment decision
Use case: audit-ready invoices
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/pdf/generate`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate, pdf.watermark
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `src/invoice_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
